ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity (white/off-white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white region occupying the central and upper fluke area. Low-intensity dark banding along the entire trailing edge. Specific low-intensity linear streaks and small focal mottling clusters concentrated near the lower central peduncle connection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 130 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels, forming a jagged continuous linear boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization located on the far distal tips of both lobes; significantly larger cluster on the left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) breaking the white pigmentation in the lower central quadrant of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark vertical rake marks near the center and heavy barnacle encrustation on the lobe tips.
